title: Injector #4 (L#4) Open Circuit Error or Short Circuit Error
detail_of_failure: Open circuit or short circuit is sensed in No.4 injector drive circuit.
machine_effect: • Defective explosion or hunting occurs. • Engine output is reduced.
related_information: • While the engine is running normally, a pulse voltage of approximately 65V is supplied to the injector (+) side. Because it is pulse voltage, it cannot be measured with the multimeter. • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Start the engine.

steps.procedure: Check the wiring harness and connector. For details, see “Related Information to Troubleshooting”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”.
1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector INJECTOR CYL 3 & 4 and connect a T-adapter to the male side.

steps.cause: Open circuit or ground fault in wiring harness
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector ECM. Connect a T-adapter to the female side.

steps.cause: Open circuit in wiring harness (wire breakage or defective contact of connector)
steps.procedure: If no failure is found by check on cause 3, this check is not required. 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and INJECTOR CYL 3 & 4, and connect a T-adapter to each female side.

steps.cause: Ground fault in wiring harness (contact with ground circuit)
steps.procedure: If no failure is found by check on cause 3, this check is not required. 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and INJECTOR CYL 3 & 4, and connect a T-adapter to one of them on the female side.

measurements.point: Between ground and ECM (female) (56) or INJECTOR CYL 3 & 4 (female) (2)

steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and INJECTOR CYL 3 & 4, and connect a T-adapter to the female side of ECM.

measurements.point: Between ECM (female) (56) and each pin other than pin (56)
Between ECM (female) (58) and each pin other than pin (58)

steps.cause: Defective other cylinder injectors or wiring harness
steps.procedure: If the failure code for abnormalities of more than one injector is shown, do the troubleshooting for this failure code first.
If no failure is found by the previous checks, the engine controller is defective. (Because this is an internal defect, troubleshooting cannot be done.)
